{{Current events|year=2018|month=12|day=8|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Corinaldo stampede]]
**Six people are killed and dozens more injured in a [[human stampede]] as frantic concertgoers try to exit a packed Lanterna Azzurra club in [[Corinaldo]] in [[Ancona Province]], [[Marche]], [[Italy]], after [[pepper spray]] is reportedly fired inside the club. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46492222 (BBC)]
*Two buses crash head-on on a highway in [[Achacachi]], [[Bolivia]], leaving at least 17 people dead and 10 injured. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&objectid=12173907 (''New Zealand Herald'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[White House Chief of Staff]] [[John F. Kelly]] is set to resign by the end of the month according to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/07/politics/john-kelly-chief-of-staff-donald-trump/index.html (CNN)]
**President Trump announces his nomination of army general [[Mark A. Milley]] to succeed marine general [[Joseph Dunford]] as [[Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-military/trump-to-nominate-milley-as-next-chairman-of-joint-chiefs-idUSKBN1O70JS (Reuters)]
*[[Yellow vests movement]]
**125,000 people demonstrate across [[France]], according to the [[Minister of the Interior (France)|Minister of the Interior]], with about 89,000 police officers on duty. 1,385 people are detained. Tear gas and pepper spray are used against the protesters and 135 people are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/france-braces-massive-yellow-vest-protests-181208055629215.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/paris-france-yellow-vest-protests-1.4938150 (CBC)]
*[[Federal Government of Belgium]]
**[[Prime Minister of Belgium|Prime Minister]] [[Charles Michel]] says that the [[New Flemish Alliance]] (N-VA) party quits the [[Michel I Government|coalition]]. N-VA cites its disagreement over the signing of the United Nations [[Global Compact for Migration]]. Michel plans to continue with a [[minority government|minority cabinet]] until the [[2019 Belgian federal election|next scheduled election]]. [https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/alles-wat-je-moet-onthouden-over-de-dag-dat-n-va-uit-de-regering-stapte~adc130e6/ (''Het Laatste Nieuws'')] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/belgian-pm-set-for-minority-after-biggest-ally-quits-coalition-11014684 (Channel News Asia)]

;Science and technology
*The [[United Launch Alliance|ULA]] launch of a [[Delta IV Heavy]] rocket carrying the [[List of NRO launches|NROL-71]] mission is called off 7 seconds before liftoff time. [https://www.nbcsandiego.com/news/california/Delta-IV-Heavy-Rocket-Launch-Rescheduled-to-Saturday---1.html (NBC San Diego)] [https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2018/12/ula-delta-iv-heavy-set-to-launch-nrol-71/ (NASA Spaceflight)]

;Sports
*In its second season, [[Atlanta United FC]] wins the [[MLS Cup 2018|MLS Cup]], defeating the [[Portland Timbers]] 2–0 in front of a record crowd of 73,019 at [[Mercedes-Benz Stadium]] in Atlanta, Georgia. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/dec/08/atlanta-united-portland-timbers-mls-cup-soccer (The Guardian)]
